lines.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
If the LORD had not been on our side—
if the LORD had not been on our side
when their anger flared against us,
then they would have swallowed us alive,
then the floods would have engulfed us,
then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler;
the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
Our help is in the name of the LORD,
the Maker of heaven and earth.

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, Victory O Lord - Moses seated on the rock with his arms held up for him, Aaron in the dark robe at one side and Hur in the red robe at the other, the gold evening sky burning behind the three of them while the fighting goes on below, a song of ascents of David, if the LORD had not been on our side let Israel now declare, if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us, when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive
pictures.name: pd_millais_aanval

pictures.scene: Willem van de Velde the Younger, De Windstoot - the ship heeling hard over in the squall with her white sail torn and the red pennant streaming from the masthead, the towering grey white cloud standing behind her and the black trough of the waves breaking open under her bow, then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us, then the raging waters would have swept us away
pictures.name: pd_velde_golven

pictures.scene: Emma Soyer, The Escape - the goldfinch flown free into the dark air above with the child standing under it, her hand opened wide and her face turned up after the bird, and the little wooden cage left standing open at her side, blessed be the LORD who has not given us as prey to their teeth, we have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler, the net is torn and we have slipped away
pictures.name: pd_soyer_ontsnapt

pictures.scene: George Inness, Peace and Plenty - the great tree standing dark against the gold evening sky with the river winding through the wide valley below it and the low hills lying along the far side, and the harvesters out among the sheaves in the meadow in front, our help is in the name of the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth
pictures.name: pd_inness_maker
